response.sql: WITH matched_records AS (SELECT o.timespan, rm.riskandmarginpivot FROM orders o INNER JOIN riskandmargin rm ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault), timespan_stats AS (SELECT timespan, COUNT(*) as count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched_records)::REAL as total, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT timespan) FROM matched_records)::REAL as num_timespans FROM matched_records GROUP BY timespan) SELECT timespan, count, count::REAL / total as share, (count::REAL / total) - (1.0 / num_timespans) as diff_from_avg FROM timespan_stats ORDER BY timespan;
